summary: Iteration 5: tested the 4 calendar enhancements end-to-end. Backend: 8 new pytest tests (remind_day_before/done defaults, handover/return calendar_event_id -> done+protocol_id, no-op without id, 400 on on-road vehicle leaves event undone, unknown id ignored, eve-reminders auth/400/202/duplicate + cron_runs {kind:'eve', date: tomorrow, sent} counting only remind=true & not-done, daily skips done with kind:'daily') plus 15 regression tests from test_calendar.py -> 23/23 pass. crons.yml has both entries (0 8 / 0 15 Europe/Berlin). Frontend (Playwright, DE+EN, desktop+mobile): month/week toggle, week grid 7 headers + none row + hour rows dynamically extended 6..21, chips in correct cells, prev/next by week (KW 44/45/46) and month, KW label in German; remind checkbox default checked, uncheck persists false, bell 15:00 tag hidden when off/done; conflict warning amber box lists existing appt, save allowed with warning toast, 'Doppelt belegt' badges + month triangle, edit does not self-warn; start-protocol handover prefill (existing driver matched / custom name input), banner, signature required, done tag after save, on-road error toast; return start-protocol -> history tab + auto-opened return dialog, done after save; no-open-handover error toast; normal handover without calendar has no banner; all tabs navigate. All features work.

minor.issue: Deleting a protocol that completed a calendar event does not reset the event (done stays true, protocol_id dangling) -> appointment stays 'Erledigt' with no protocol and no reminders
calendar_event_id is not validated (vehicle/type mismatch or unknown id silently accepted/ignored). Low risk since only UI sends it

ui_bugs.issue: Toast 'Fahrzeug ist bereits unterwegs' shown twice (React.StrictMode double-invokes mount effect in dev). Same for 'Keine offene Übergabe' potentially. Use toast id e.g. toast.error(msg, {id:'proto-intent'}) to dedupe
Date formatted with browser locale (toLocaleDateString()) -> '11/4/2026' in German UI; should use i18n language (4.11.2026)

issues: No hint/banner that this return will mark the calendar appointment done (handover form has one) - consider consistency
During close animation of edit dialog, title briefly flips to 'Termin hinzufügen' (state nulled before animation ends)
Date/time use native browser pickers (US format 11/04/2026 in German UI) instead of shadcn calendar
'SIGN HERE' / 'Clear' not translated in German UI (pre-existing)
Header controls wrap so prev and next arrows are split across two lines around the label

action_items: Optional: on protocol delete, reset linked calendar_events (done=false, protocol_id=null) where protocol_id matches
Optional: dedupe intent toasts with a toast id
Optional: format handover-from-calendar date with i18n language
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ~919 lines and ProtocolsTab.jsx ~730 lines exceed 700-line guideline; consider splitting (calendar router module; HistoryList/ReturnDialog into own files)
WeekGrid defines Cell component inside render -> remounts all cells every render; make it a top-level component
useClashes fetches on every vehicle/date change without debounce - fine for now
Conflict detection counts done events too (a completed handover + a new appointment same day still flagged) - acceptable but consider excluding done
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Alpha/Beta/Gamma vehicles, TEST_Anna driver, calendar events and protocols for UI tests; all cleaned up via ui_seed_it5.py cleanup (vehicle delete cascades events, handover delete removes returns). Backend tests clean up their own data and cron_runs docs.

Seed helper: python /app/backend/tests/ui_seed_it5.py (writes /tmp/it5_seed.json) and 'cleanup' arg.
